title: Learned resistance models expose tested enzyme-substrate activities
summary: Interrogating models trained on genome and resistance data nominated enzyme-substrate relationships for experimental testing. The authors report 22 previously unknown activities validated in their assay system. This is one mechanism study; it does not establish the prevalence or clinical contribution of each relationship in patients. Model performance varied substantially across organism and drug datasets.

evidence.tested: Predicted relationships received targeted experimental validation.
evidence.unknown: Clinical prevalence, generalization and independent replication remain unestablished.
evidence.ai_role: Antibiotic-specific logistic-regression classifiers supported the stated study; experimental and interpretive work remained with researchers.

source_review.scope: Primary article date, affiliations, selected logistic-regression Methods and experimental Results; supplements not reviewed.
